name: 8085 Load and Copy
desc: This is a simple 8085 assembly language program that loads the value 23H into register D and the value 5643H into register BC. It then copies the content of register D to register A and halts the program.

files.sketch.ino:
; LOAD 23H to register D and 5643H to register BC. 
; Copy the content of D register to A register.

;CODE:
MVI D,23H
LXI B,5643H
MOV A,D
HLT

;END OF CODE
